failure_evidence.stage: Python import before model construction or CUDA allocation
failure_evidence.interpretation: environment dependency failure only; not checkpoint loading, generation, evaluator, metric, or GPU failure
failure_evidence.next_action: install the official soundfile pin and retry only in a fresh separately registered smoke directory

scope: One official JavisDiT-v1.0 generated audio-video sample to verify checkpoint loading and output provenance. It is not JavisBench-mini evaluation, a paper metric, training, or model comparison.

generation_protocol.prompt_source: official JavisDiT README example prompt: ocean waves on a quiet rocky shore at dawn

required_closeout: exit status and full launch log retained
all produced MP4/WAV files listed with SHA-256
ffprobe/decode result retained for each produced media file
no overwrite of any existing output directory
state remains smoke-only even if media generation succeeds
prohibited_actions: no use of GPUs 0-3 or termination of external processes
no reuse of mini benchmark output directory
stopping_rule: If GPU 4 preflight observes meaningful external compute use, do not launch. Any model-load/runtime failure is preserved as smoke evidence only.
